올데이 활력엔 비타민BNiacin · Magnesium · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by 우리바이오(주) · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 50mg of Niacin, 94.5mg of Magnesium, 50μg of Biotin, 50mg of Vitamin B1, 50μg of Vitamin B12, 50mg of Vitamin B2, 50mg of Vitamin B6, 100mg of Vitamin C, 1000μg of Folate, 50mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 50mg Niacin, 94.5mg Magnesium, 50μg Biotin, 50mg Vitamin B1, 50μg Vitamin B12, 50mg Vitamin B2, 50mg Vitamin B6, 100mg Vitamin C, 1000μg Folate, 50mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 우리바이오(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Magnesium
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)
